analysis: fixed-lag binary event dependence only; no labels, fitting, or prediction

manifest.selection: first 8 row-group-sorted entries from each existing seeded 32-sequence split/class stratum; no reselection

method.events: component changed from preceding row; each 10,000-row half starts with false events
method.positive_lag: i1 event at t paired with later i0 event at t+lag
method.negative_control: circularly roll i1 price event by 1000 rows within each half; preserves event count and cyclic i1 autocorrelation, randomizes phase relative to i0
method.aggregation: per-sequence average of its two halves; medians/means/sign fractions over sequences, no row-level standard errors or iid claims
